staff_finance.cost.prices.description: Heading of a cost item's prices, each with the date it applies from, and of the form of a new price.

staff_finance.cost.revise.description: Button that records a new price of a cost item from a date.

staff_finance.cost.revise.date.description: Field of a new price of a cost item: the date from which the payments take it.

staff_finance.cost.revise.date_before.defaultMessage: 最初の支払日以降の日付を選んでください。
staff_finance.cost.revise.date_before.description: Under the date of a new price of a cost item when it is before the first payment.

staff_finance.cost.revise.done.defaultMessage: {date} から {price} になりました。
staff_finance.cost.revise.done.description: Said once a new price of a cost item is recorded.

staff_finance.cost.revise.amount.description: Field of a new price of a cost item. {currency} is its currency's code.

staff_finance.cost.label.description: Heading of the form that changes a cost item's name, provider, category and memo.

staff_finance.cost.label.save.description: Button that saves a cost item's name, provider, category and memo.

staff_finance.cost.label.done.description: Said once a cost item's name, provider, category and memo are saved.

staff_finance.cost.end.description: Heading of the form of a repeating cost item's last payment date.

staff_finance.cost.end.date.description: Field of a repeating cost item's last payment date, on its screen.

staff_finance.cost.end.set.description: Button that sets a repeating cost item's last payment date. Its payments after that date go away; past ones stay.

staff_finance.cost.end.move.description: Button that moves a repeating cost item's last payment date.

staff_finance.cost.end.remove.description: Button that makes a repeating cost item go on with no end.

staff_finance.cost.end.done.defaultMessage: 最後の支払日を {date} にしました。
staff_finance.cost.end.done.description: Said once a repeating cost item's last payment date is set.

staff_finance.cost.end.removed.defaultMessage: 終わりのない費用にしました。
staff_finance.cost.end.removed.description: Said once a repeating cost item's end is removed.

staff_finance.cost.delete.description: Heading of the last section of a cost item's screen, which deletes it.

staff_finance.cost.delete.about.defaultMessage: 削除すると、過去の期間も含めてすべての期間からこの費用を除きます。取り消せません。
staff_finance.cost.delete.about.description: Under Delete on a cost item's screen, and in its confirmation.

staff_finance.cost.delete.ask.description: Button that asks before deleting a cost item.

staff_finance.cost.delete.confirm.description: Title of the confirmation of deleting a cost item. {name} is its name.

staff_finance.cost.delete.do.description: Button of the confirmation that deletes a cost item.

staff_finance.cost.write_failed.defaultMessage: 保存されていません。接続を確認してから、もう一度試してください。
staff_finance.cost.write_failed.description: Said when a change of a cost item failed for a reason that names no field.

staff_finance.cost.amount.invalid.defaultMessage: 金額を数字で書いてください。小数は通貨の桁まで (1650、12.50)。
staff_finance.cost.amount.invalid.description: Under an amount of a cost item when it is not a number, or has more decimals than its currency.
